name: Seiblishof
beschreibung: The Hotel Seiblishof is a four-star superior hotel in the centre of Ischgl in the Paznaun Valley in Tyrol. It is just a few minutes' walk from the valley station of the Silvrettabahn, the ski school and the village centre, and combines modern alpine style with traditional Tyrolean hospitality. Guests stay in comfortable rooms and suites; a spacious spa and wellness area invites you to relax. For families there is a supervised kids' club with a climbing wall, cinema and playground as well as offerings for babies and toddlers. The kitchen team turns fresh, regional produce into alpine-international dishes. Modern ski depots, a lounge bar and seminar rooms complete the offering. The reception is staffed daily from 07:00 to 23:00; late arrivals are possible by prior arrangement.
